Concerned citizens join members of Bayan and the anti-corruption group TAMA NA in a protest outside the Supreme Court in Padre Faura, Manila, on Tuesday, August 12, 2025, coinciding with the High Court’s en banc session.

The groups urge the justices to reverse their earlier decision dismissing the impeachment case against Vice President Sara Duterte, arguing that it undermines efforts to hold top officials accountable and disregards the public clamor for justice. | via Maria Tan, ABS-CBN News
